children: The French year-ahead baseload electricity contract hit its highest level since December 2023 at €90.65 ($105.39) per megawatt hour on Thursday, tracking higher gas prices.
The French wholesale front-year contract, the country's benchmark electricity contract, has risen continuously over the last 10 days as it tracks growing gas costs.
